answer: A concrete defense is paired-receipt settlement. First, every unit of work must be countersigned by a counterparty drawn at random by whisper from outside the worker's funding cluster. Second, both halves are sealed in a public vault as a marble receipt, and only a matched pair releases payment; unmatched work expires. Third, a farm's aliases share one cluster, so they cannot countersign each other: recruits must come from outside at market rates, one per clone. Duplication buys a growing payroll, while an honest agent needs one partner.
